title: Mixed Conditionals
completion_message: ¡Formidable! Los Mixed Conditionals son quizás la estructura gramatical más sofisticada del inglés. Conectan el pasado con el presente o el presente con el pasado para expresar situaciones hipotéticas complejas con una precisión y madurez que solo tienen los hablantes de nivel C.

parts.visual:
Los Mixed Conditionals mezclan tiempos de diferentes condicionales para expresar ideas complejas. 

Tipo 1 - Efecto PRESENTE de causa PASADA (el más común en negocios): 
- Estructura: IF + Past Perfect, WOULD + Infinitive. 
- Significado: Si algo en el PASADO hubiera sido diferente, el PRESENTE sería diferente. 
Ej: IF he had studied law, he WOULD BE a lawyer now. (Si hubiera estudiado Derecho, ahora SERÍA abogado). 
Ej: IF we hadn't taken that risk, the company WOULD NOT EXIST today.
parts.audio: Mixed Conditionals combine tenses from different conditional types to express complex ideas. Type 1 shows the PRESENT effect of a PAST cause. Structure: If, plus Past Perfect, comma, Would plus infinitive. Meaning: If something in the PAST had been different, the PRESENT would be different. For example: If he had studied law, he would be a lawyer now. This means he didn't study law in the past, so he is not a lawyer now. Another example: If we hadn't taken that risk, the company would not exist today.

parts.visual:
Tipo 2 - Efecto PASADO de causa PRESENTE (menos común pero muy sofisticado): 
- Estructura: IF + Past Simple, WOULD HAVE + Participio Pasado. 
- Significado: Si una situación PRESENTE fuera diferente, algo en el PASADO habría sido diferente. 
Ej: IF he were more organized, he WOULD HAVE FINISHED the report yesterday. (Si fuera más organizado, habría terminado el informe ayer). 
Ej: IF I were an expert, I WOULD HAVE PREDICTED this crisis.
parts.audio: Type 2 shows the PAST effect of a PRESENT cause. Structure: If, plus Past Simple, comma, Would Have plus Past Participle. Meaning: If a PRESENT situation were different, something in the PAST would have been different. For example: If he were more organized, he would have finished the report yesterday. This means he is NOT organized now, and because of that, he DID NOT finish the report yesterday. Another example: If I were an expert, I would have predicted this crisis.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el Mixed Conditional correcto según el tipo (pasado→presente o presente→pasado).

questions.question: If she had gone to university, she ____ a professor now. (Efecto presente de causa pasada).
questions.explanation: Past Perfect → WOULD BE (now). Causa pasada → efecto presente.

questions.question: If he were more decisive, he ____ the deal last month. (Efecto pasado de causa presente).
questions.explanation: Past Simple (were) → WOULD HAVE + Participle. Condición presente → resultado pasado.

questions.question: If I ____ more carefully in school, I would understand financial reports now.
questions.explanation: Estructura tipo 1: IF + Past Perfect... would + infinitivo (now).

questions.question: If we were a larger company, we ____ secured the funding last year.
questions.explanation: WOULD HAVE + secured (resultado pasado de condición presente).

questions.question: If he had accepted the promotion, he ____ our CEO today.
questions.explanation: Causa pasada (rejected) → efecto presente (today). WOULD BE.

questions.question: If I were a native English speaker, I ____ the presentation much better yesterday.
questions.explanation: Condición presente (not native) → resultado pasado (yesterday). WOULD HAVE + delivered.

questions.question: If they ____ the project on time, they would still be a trusted supplier.
questions.explanation: IF + Past Perfect (causa pasada) → WOULD + infinitivo (resultado presente, 'still').

questions.question: If she were truly committed, she ____ the project on time. (Pasado resultado).
questions.explanation: Condición presente (she's not committed) → resultado pasado. WOULD HAVE + finished.

questions.question: If we had diversified our portfolio in 2010, we ____ very wealthy now.
questions.explanation: Causa pasada → estado presente (now). WOULD BE.

questions.question: If I were better at negotiation, I ____ a much better deal last week.
questions.explanation: Característica presente (poor negotiator) → resultado pasado (last week).

questions.question: If he ____ the warning signs, he wouldn't be in so much debt now.
questions.explanation: IF + Past Perfect → WOULDN'T BE (now). Causa pasada → efecto presente.

questions.question: If she were less risk-averse, she ____ invested in Bitcoin early on.
questions.explanation: WOULD HAVE + invested. Carácter presente → resultado pasado.

questions.question: If I had joined that startup in 2015, I ____ a millionaire right now.
questions.explanation: Causa pasada → estado presente (right now). WOULD BE.

questions.question: If our team were more innovative, we ____ that product first. (They launched before us).
questions.explanation: Característica presente → resultado pasado.

questions.question: If the CEO ____ that investment, the company wouldn't be struggling today.
questions.explanation: IF + Past Perfect Negative → WOULDN'T BE (today). Causa pasada → efecto presente.

questions.question: If they were more experienced, they ____ caught that accounting error last quarter.
questions.explanation: Experiencia presente → resultado pasado (last quarter). WOULD HAVE + caught.

questions.question: If he had built a stronger network, he ____ unemployed now.
questions.explanation: Causa pasada → estado presente negativo (now). WOULDN'T BE.

questions.question: If I were a better public speaker, my presentation ____ gone better last month.
questions.explanation: Habilidad presente → resultado pasado (last month). WOULD HAVE + gone.

questions.question: If they ____ that market earlier, they would dominate it today.
questions.explanation: IF + Past Perfect → WOULD + infinitivo (today = presente). Causa pasada.

questions.question: If our culture were less hierarchical, we ____ that talented engineer who resigned last year.
questions.explanation: Cultura presente → resultado pasado (resigned last year). WOULD HAVE + kept.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la forma verbal correcta para el Mixed Conditional.

questions.question: If she had studied law, she ____ a lawyer now. (would be / would have been)
questions.explanation: would be (causa pasada → efecto presente).

questions.question: If he were more careful, he ____ that mistake. (would have avoided / would avoid)
questions.explanation: would have avoided (condición presente → resultado pasado).

questions.question: If I ____ that company, I'd be rich now. (had bought / bought)
questions.explanation: had bought (IF + Past Perfect → would be now).

questions.question: If we were bolder, we ____ first. (would have launched / would launch)
questions.explanation: would have launched (condición presente → resultado pasado).

questions.question: If he hadn't quit, he ____ the CEO today. (would be / would have been)
questions.explanation: would be (causa pasada → estado presente).

questions.question: If I ____ native English, I'd have written it better. (were / had been)
questions.explanation: were (condición presente → resultado pasado).

questions.question: If they ____ saved more, they wouldn't be in debt now. (had / have)
questions.explanation: had saved (IF + Past Perfect → wouldn't be now).

questions.question: If she were disciplined, she ____ finished on time. (would have / would)
questions.explanation: would have finished (condición presente → resultado pasado).

questions.question: If he ____ that investment, he'd be retired now. (had made / made)
questions.explanation: had made (causa pasada → efecto presente).

questions.question: If I were more experienced, I ____ that error last year. (would have caught / would catch)
questions.explanation: would have caught (condición presente → resultado pasado).

pairs.source: If + Past Simple → would have + participle
If he had studied, he would be...
If she were organized, she would have finished...
If they hadn't merged, they would be bankrupt.
pairs.target: Si no se hubieran fusionado, ahora estarían en quiebra.

pairs.source: If I were bilingual, I would have gotten the job.
pairs.target: Si fuera bilingüe, habría conseguido el trabajo.

pairs.source: He would be rich now if he had invested.
pairs.target: Sería rico ahora si hubiera invertido.

pairs.source: If the team were faster, they would have won.
pairs.target: Si el equipo fuera más rápido, habrían ganado.

pairs.source: I wouldn't be here if I hadn't taken that risk.
pairs.target: No estaría aquí si no hubiera tomado ese riesgo.

pairs.source: If she were confident, she would have spoken up.
